# P04 repair checkpoint

Recovery attempt 2 complete: all nine declared P04 files exist, including both
required deliverables, checker, fixture catalog and 17 unittest methods. The old
checkpoint was stale. Fresh execution now supplies the result evidence. No required
P04 deliverable is unfinished. The supervisor phase-entry inventory is available.

The approved plan and complete structured review were inspected. Skeptical audit:
parent versus conditional-view separation, numerical correctness and coverage were
checked. Independent Fraction enumeration and
analytic endpoints remain the comparators. No test count or solver success is a
promotion criterion for accounting validity. Missing protection evidence or changed
protected files veto acceptance; numerical failures trigger local repairs.

All 384 phase-entry hashes match before and after the checker. Repairs reject lossy rational-record
coercion, empty/malformed domains, duplicate finite values, generated-name collisions
and duplicate contract identities. Iterative lazy enumeration preserves exact
cardinality for ranges larger than sys.maxsize. Independent overlapping-guard
enumeration checks disjoint coverage. Principal/rate mutation tests include reversed
endpoint order and verify the parent interior and isolated conditional query.
